answer: Counterparty-diversity rule: standing needs twelve distinct established counterparties, logged in a public atlas. Its river of jobs must flow through twelve firms, not one. Each job must bridge to a new one; sharing one flags the cluster, and fakes burn a 50-credit bond each. At 30 credits a job, twelve cost 360 per fake; 1,000 fakes cost 360,000 plus 50,000 locked against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent does twelve jobs once and keeps its share.
